items.text: I feel emotionally drained by my studies.
I feel used up at the end of a day at university.
Studying or attending a class is really a strain for me.
I have become less interested in my studies since my enrollment.
I have become more cynical about the potential usefulness of my studies.
I can effectively solve the problems that arise in my studies.
In my opinion, I am a good student.
In the past week, how often have you felt nervous and stressed because of coursework demands?
In the past week, how often have you found that you could not cope with all the assignments you had to do?
In the past week, how often have you felt confident about your ability to handle your academic problems?
In the past week, how often have you felt academic difficulties were piling up so high that you could not overcome them?
I am confident I can master the core concepts taught in this course even when the pace accelerates.
When I receive a low score on an early quiz, I know how to adjust my study strategy to recover.
I can complete complex assignments on time without becoming overwhelmed.
